storyOromo: Gaafa tokko leenci muka jalatti rafaa ture. Hantuutni xiqqoon isa irratti fiigde. Leenci aaree hantuuta qabate. Garuu hantuutni dhiifama gaafate.
storyEnglish: One day a lion was sleeping under a tree. A small mouse ran over him. The lion became angry and caught the mouse. The mouse asked for forgiveness.

storyOromo: Sareen tokko abbaa isaa jaallataa fi eeggataa ture.
storyEnglish: A dog loved and protected his owner.
